Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this match and series. A pretty one-sided result, as expected, but if you have followed it closely, there were moments when the Dutch team ran the Kiwis close. It's a good learning tour for them as they sign off. It's time for us to also bid you farewell. You can keep checking the fixture page for all the upcoming games. Until we meet again, it's goodbye and cheers.

'Ross the Boss' will be missed! What a champion player and what a career! With his retirement, the golden era of New Zealand cricket truly comes to an end. A few months back we saw his last in Test cricket and here he is, putting a full stop to his international career. Certainly, one of the icons of Kiwi cricket who played a massive role as a leader and in the supporting cast to lift the fortunes of the Black Caps. If the renaissance of New Zealand cricket is credited to Brendon McCullum, one must remember Taylor's contribution, both as the captain of the ship and the star batter of the team whose career almost flew under the radar. To have a 16-year old career in this day and age, to maintain fitness and to play consistently well at the top of your power - you need stamina, tenacity, courage, gumption, desire and character, and Luteru Ross Poutoa Lote Taylor had all those qualities in bulk. The Pallekele Plunderer bids adieu to this game and we have only appreciation and gratitude. Thanks for all the memories and those tongue-poke celebrations.

Ross Taylor, the man of the moment, talks for one final time as a New Zealand cricketer. He appreciates everyone who has contributed to his career. Praises the Dutch team and hopes that they play many more games against the big teams and get better. A special mention from him for the manager of the New Zealand team who is also moving on and wishes him best for his future. Rosco thanks his teammates and says that he will be watching from far how they will grow and will miss them all. He thanks his wife, parents, family and friends. Calls it a fantastic 16 years and shares that they have a massive influence on him as a cricketer and person. Lastly, an emotional Ross Taylor thanks the crowd for turning out in large numbers for this game.

Tom Latham, the winning captain of New Zealand, says that it's nice to finish the series off with a win. Tells that in this match, building the partnership was the key. Admits that with the ball, they weren't at their best but got the job done. Further says that the Dutch team put them under pressure on many occasions in this series and they got out of it really well. Adds that they will take positives and learnings from those games. Latham is happy with the way new players performed in the absence of the regular players and showed the depth of the squad. On Ross Taylor, Latham replies that he has been a massive servant to New Zealand cricket and it's going to be a different feeling to not have his name on the scoresheet. Further says that he appreciates every time he played with him and lauds the longevity of his successful career. Says that he loved having the Dutch team around and hopes that they will take many positives into their summer of cricket.

Pieter Seelaar, the Dutch skipper, says that it was a little bit disappointing, but New Zealand stepped up properly in the last game and the partnership between Guptill and Young was incredible. Mentions that they wanted to test themselves at a higher level and the idea was to see how long they can stay in the game. He wants his team to be more gutsy. Shares that the second game was special for them when they grabbed 5 quick wickets. On the knock of Stephan Myburgh, he calls it a vintage knock and is amazed at the way he signed off. Shares that they will go straight into their summer and start preparing for future assignments. Thanks the crowd for all the support.

Will Young is the Player of the Match and Series! Says it was tricky against the new balls, but they got off to a decent start and then carried the momentum. Mentions that Guptill played well and supported him when he was struggling and he did the same when Guptill struggled initially. Tells that it was good to get over 300 on the board. Concludes by saying that it was special to get his century with a six, and with Ross Taylor at the other end.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Early in the match, New Zealand's decision to bat first turned out to be correct. Despite losing an early wicket, they batted with full control and soon gained the upper hand. The pair of Martin Guptill and Will Young stitched in a big double century stand and both the batters completed their hundreds as well. The target set by them was always going to be tough but the Netherlands didn't surrender and tried their best.

After the first 10 overs, the Dutch team was never in the game as they struggled to keep up with the required rate and the pressure started to mount. A few batters got starts and spent time in the middle but their knocks were of no use in the context of the chase. Tom Latham kept rotating his bowlers smartly and everyone contributed.

Chasing a mammoth target, the Netherlands got off to a flying start courtesy of an incredible knock from Stephan Myburgh. They raced to 74 runs in Powerplay 1 and looked well in the hunt. That said, it was always a matter of one wicket for the Kiwis and Colin de Grandhomme provided them with that by removing Myburgh. His cunning slower ones were hard to get away with and Ish Sodhi's introduction further helped New Zealand in drying up the runs.

Farewell Ross Taylor! Handshakes and hugs all around. The crowd is on its feet to applaud him. Emotional moment for Rosco as he leads the players off the park. The series is won 3-0 by the Black Caps with a thumping victory.

OUT! CAUGHT BY ROSCO! The last hand to end this match belongs to Ross Taylor. Fitting end. The crowd screams in joy. Matt Henry digs it in short, around middle, Aryan Dutt stays back to pull but does so without any timing. It lobs up to mid-wicket and Ross Taylor displays his bucket hands for one final time. Taylor smiles. New Zealand win by 115 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Ross Taylor b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Shout for an lbw! Henry serves it on a length around middle and leg, Fred Klaassen fails to flick and is hit on the pads. It goes down to fine leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Fuller and on off, driven down to mid off.
Huge roar from the crowd in anticipation. They want Ross Taylor to bowl. Tom Latham has brought Matt Henry in and gets boos from the crowd.
Shortish and on off, Fred Klaassen runs it down to third man and takes a single.
Wide! Doug Bracewell goes for pace but hurls a length ball down the leg side, Fred Klaassen tries to buy easy runs off his pads but fails to get any bat behind it.
Full and on middle, angling in, Fred Klaassen turns inside the crease and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Fred Klaassen is the last batter in.

OUT! Clattered! A pinpoint yorker, around off and at 108 clicks. It's too good for Clayton Floyd. He tries to dig it out but plays down the wrong line. The ball beats the outside edge as it arrives late and then goes on to tickle the off stump. New Zealand are only one away from 3-0!
Too full in length, on middle at 127 kph, it's kept out safely to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, angling in, Clayton Floyd pushes it down to mid on.
Bracewell runs in hard but bowls a slower one, full and on middle, Dutt flicks it a bit aerially but wide of square leg. A single is taken.
Doug Bracewell (6-1-20-1) is back into the attack.
Fuller and on off, it's forced down to long on for a run.
Short again from Sodhi, around off, Aryan Dutt punches but finds the cover fielder.
Shortish delivery, a leg spinner, it's punched off the back foot to covers.
Loopy and full, around off, driven off the front foot to point.
Googly again, full and around off, Dutt tries to sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Googly, short and on off, Dutt punches it to covers.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this innings.
Beaten! Quicker and fuller outside off, skidding straight on, Clayton Floyd tries to drive but misses.
Drops it short and on middle, it's pulled to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Clayton Floyd is the new batter.

OUT! Michael Bracewell gets his first wicket of the match and Logan van Beek's cameo has come to an end! A flatter delivery, quicker as well. Logan van Beek gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this, but he misses and gets rapped on his front pad. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger immediately. That looked plump! The Netherlands are now 8 down!
Spinning in, around middle. Logan van Beek blocks it out off the back foot.
We have lost the ball again. The reserve umpire is out again with a box of balls. Hang on, they have found the ball, someone has thrown it back.
SIX! DISPATCHED! A fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Logan van Beek gets down on his knee and smashes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Spinning in, around middle. Aryan Dutt nudges it towards mid-wicket off the back foot for a single.
SIX! Up and over! Tosses this one up, full, around middle, Logan van Beek tonks it over the bowler's head for a biggie. He aspires to play for New Zealand and is showing his batting prowess.
Shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Logan van Beek pulls but finds the fielder at mid on once again. No run there!
Loopy delivery, full, around middle. Logan van Beek knocks it to the fielder at mid on
A leg spinner, outside off, shorter ball. Logan van Beek pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Tosses it up now, full, outside off. Aryan Dutt knocks it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off, spinning away sharply. Aryan Dutt pushes it towards covers.
Short again, spinning in around middle. Aryan Dutt pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Tad shorter, outside off. Aryan Dutt pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Cut away! Outside off, short in length. Aryan Dutt hangs back and slashes it past point for another boundary.
Fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Logan van Beek tucks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fuller ball, around middle and off. Logan van Beek, once again reverse-sweeps it past gully for a boundary.
Pitches it up, outside off. Logan van Beek reverse-sweeps past point for a brace.
Michael Bracewell is back into the attack. 0/32 in his 4 overs so far.
Tosses it up, full and outside off, Aryan Dutt pushes it to mid off.
Beauty! A ripper! Fuller delivery, this one lands around off and spins away. Aryan Dutt stays in the crease and looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Shorter now, around middle, Logan van Beek miscues his pull shot towards square leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! That sounded so sweet as soon as it left the bat! Fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Logan van Beek gets down on his knee and smashes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Another leg spinner, outside off, a tad quicker. Logan van Beek cuts it towards point.
Fuller ball, spinning away, around off. Logan van Beek taps it towards covers off the back foot.
Pitches it up this time, around off. Aryan Dutt pushes it towards mid off.
Doug Bracewell drops it short now, around middle, at 129.3 clicks. Aryan Dutt leans back and leaves it alone.
On a length again, around middle and off. Aryan Dutt blocks it out.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Aryan Dutt blocks it out solidly.
Angling in again on the pads, on a length. Logan van Beek flicks it towards square leg for a single.
On a length, angling in, around middle. Logan van Beek is squared up in his defense.
Beaten! Slows this one in the air, lands it around off and it turns away, Aryan Dutt gets forward to defend but misses. A wicket maiden for Ish!
The batter has just blocked that from his crease.
Aryan Dutt comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's an incredible catch from Michael Bracewell. He made that look so easy. Loopy delivery, full and around off, Michael Rippon goes down on one knee and slogs it over mid-wicket. It's a flat hit as it travels quickly to the deep and Michael Bracewell snaps it inches above the surface. The umpires get it checked upstairs and the replays show that it's a clean catch. Another one bites the dust for the Dutch team.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Floated one, full and on middle, straightening a touch after landing. Rippon goes down with the reverse sweep but it's clipped the gloves.
Play and a miss! Sharp spin away from the right-hander, outside off, Rippon backs away and tries to cut but misses.
Tossed up, full and on off, Rippon reverse-sweeps it from the bottom part of his blade and it goes to first slip.
Short in length and on top of off, Logan van Beek punches it off his back foot but finds the point fielder.
Back of a length, on off, it's tapped down to square leg for a run.
The line is straight, on a length, van Beek works it to deep square leg for a run.
Cut in half! This one lands on a length around off, shaping back in, Logan van Beek stays back to defend but it beats the inside edge and goes to the keeper.
Around off, on a length, defended back.
Begins by angling in a full ball around off, Logan van Beek is opened up a shade in his defense as he blocks it to the off side.

Drinks! New Zealand are well under control! They are just 4 wickets away now from clinching this game and the series. A tough task for the Netherlands, only a miracle can help them get over the line here. They need 159 off 102 balls. Doug Bracewell (4-1-17-1) comes back to bowl.
Uppish but safe! Floated and around leg, turning away, Rippon tries to flick it from the line but it takes the leading edge and goes wide of first slip.
Extra flight on this delivery, full and on off, Rippon drives but finds the cover fielder.
Drags his length short, outside off and turning away, Rippon mistimes his shot back to the bowler.
FOUR! Fine shot! Loopy again from Sodhi, full and around off, Rippon brings out the reverse-batted shot and nails it through short third man for a boundary.
Loopy and full, outside off, van Beek fetches it from there and sweeps it to mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Short and on off, turning away, Rippon goes back and slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Ish Sodhi (5-0-18-0) comes back to bowl.
Movement back into the batter, van Beek fails to flick and it goes off his pads to mid-wicket. 13 from the over!
Slightly short and on middle, Michael Rippon glances it to deep square leg for a run.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, on a good length, Rippon tries to work it away off his pads but misses.
Slower and fuller, on middle, Rippon works it in front of square on the leg side. Taylor is quick to latch onto the ball.
Digs it in short, around middle and leg, it's pulled down to fine leg for a run.

Caught off a Free Hit! Around off, on a length, Michael Rippon hits it aerially off the back foot but without much timing. The mid off fielder catches it and throws it immediately to the bowler as the batters cross.

SIX! Michael Rippon makes full use of the Free Hit!  A near-yorker on middle, Rippon gets underneath it and launches it over the bowler's head for a maximum. It's another no ball, a big one from Jamieson. Another Free Hit to follow...
A yorker around off, Logan digs it out through point for a single. Called a no ball and Free Hit is loading...
In the air... Short and around off, holding up a bit, Logan plays a mistimed pull shot and luckily for him, it doesn't carry to Sodhi at mid on.
EDGY FOUR! Short again from Henry, outside off, Rippon throws his bat at it and it takes the under edge. It flies past the keeper and races away to the fine leg fence.
Short and on middle, pulled down to fine leg for a run.
Spicy delivery, short and around off, Logan van Beek goes on his toes and fends it away on the off side.
On a length and around off, hit across the line but straight to mid on.
Back of a length, around off, steered wide of point for a single.
Fuller and on off, driven off the outer half to cover-point.
A slower yorker, around middle. Logan van Beek digs it out back to the bowler.
A leg cutter this time, on a length, outside off. Logan van Beek dabs it towards gully.
Wide for height! Very short on this occasion, around middle. The ball sails over Logan van Beek.
Marginally short now, around middle. Logan van Beek presents the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Angling in on the pads, fuller delivery. Logan van Beek flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Very full this time, another slower ball, around off. Michael Rippon pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
FOUR! Michael Rippon gets off the mark in style! A slower ball, outside off, on a length. Michael Rippon waits for it and smashes it over cover for a boundary.
Another bouncer, and Logan van Beek ducks underneath it. A double-wicket maiden for Matt Henry!
A shorter ball now, around middle. Logan van Beek ducks under it.
A fuller ball, around middle. Logan van Beek leans and defends it out. Logan van Beek survives the hat-trick ball!

Logan van Beek walks in next to face the hat-trick ball. Ha! Ha! What happened there? Henry thought that he is done with the over and gone to his fielding position. Three balls are still pending. That's some miscalculation from the bowler and also from the umpire. Smiles all around as Matt returns to his bowling mark.

OUT! CAUGHT AT SLIP! Two in two for Matt Henry! Great bowling, cleaned up de Leede with a yorker and gets Pieter Seelaar out fending at a short delivery. The skipper of the Netherlands departs on his very first delivery! Matt Henry drops it short this time, around off, at 131 kph. Pieter Seelaar hops, opens the face of the bat, and tries to guide it towards third man. The ball goes off the splice of the bat and lobs towards Martin Guptill at first slip, who pouches it safely. Matt Henry is on a hat-trick here!
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Skipper Pieter Seelaar is in next. A slip in place.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! A beautiful delivery by Matt Henry! He grabs his second wicket and Netherlands have lost half their side now. A perfect yorker, on middle, at 121.2 kph. Bas de Leede backs away, and tries to squeeze it out, but he misses. The ball goes on to knock the stumps.
Fuller in length, around middle. Bas de Leede pushes it towards mid on.
Pitches it up this time, around middle and off. Michael Rippon shows the full face of the bat and drives it to mid off. A wicket maiden by Kyle Jamieson!
Well bowled! A slower ball, yorker-length delivery, around middle. Michael Rippon squeezes it out towards point. He wants a single there but is sent back by his partner.
Angling in, around middle, tad shorter this time. Michael Rippon defends it out off the back foot.
Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Michael Rippon leaves it alone.
Michael Rippon is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The extra bounce generated by Kyle Jamieson plays a big role in this breakthrough. It's short and on middle, at 119.4 kph, Scott Edwards tries to pull but the bounce gets big on his bat. It kisses the top edge and flies behind to the keeper. Tom Latham shuffles across to his left and takes a simple catch. 190 needed off 136 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Kyle Jamieson

Commentary.Commentary: Starts with an off-pace delivery. Short and outside off, at 103 kph, Scott Edwards mistimes his square cut to point.
Kyle Jamieson is back for his second spell.
Marginally short now, darting it on the hips. Scott Edwards tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Scott Edwards pushes it back to the bowler.
Very full this time, outside off. Bas de Leede makes room and drives it towards cover-point for a single.
A length delivery, around middle and off. Scott Edwards flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Shorter ball, down the leg side. Scott Edwards leaves it alone. Wide called!
Back of a length, around middle. Scott Edwards blocks it out.
Fuller delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for a couple of runs.
Too full this time, around middle. Bas de Leede dances down the pitch once again and blocks it out. 10 from the over, Netherlands trying to switch gears.
FOUR! Lovey shot! Fuller ball, around middle, Bas de Leede dances down the pitch and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Tad shorter now, outside off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
Fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Scott Edwards tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Perfect execution! Tosses it up, fuller, around middle, Scott Edwards gets low and reverse-sweeps it towards third man for a boundary.
Fuller ball, around off. Bas de Leede drives it towards long on for a single.
Scott Edwards walks out to bat now.

OUT! GIVEN LBW! 100 wickets in ODIs for Matt Henry. The speedster bowls a very full ball as the follow-up delivery to the last bouncer. He has speared it in on middle, Vikramjit Singh is beaten for pace and misses the ball. He is pinged on the front pad, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Tom Latham decides to review the decision and the Ball Tracking comes up with three reds. Yet another decision is reversed this evening and New Zealand have broken the partnership. 206 needed more at the halfway stage.
Review! New Zealand have reviewed an LBW decision against Vikramjit Singh. No bat involved confirms the UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates three reds! A successful review and Vikramjit Singh departs!
Henry cooks a sharp bouncer, around middle, Singh ducks.
Slower one, full and around off, Singh defends it off his front foot to covers.
Digs it in short, around off, de Leede plays a mistimed pull shot in the air towards square leg. It falls safely and they cross.
Fuller this time, around off, Bas de Leede defends it with the angle of the bowler to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off at 130.7 kph, Bas de Leede defends it off his back foot.
Matt Henry (3-0-23-0) is back into the attack.
Looped one, full and on off, Vikramjit Singh strides forward and pushes it defensively to covers. 7 from the over, 207 needed off 156 balls.
Flatter off spinner, a bit short and around off, Bas goes back and punches it to mid-wicket for a run.
Slower through the air, full and around off, turning away, Singh slices his drive through cover-point for one.
Quicker and flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Nice shot! Tossed up, full and around middle, Singh gets behind the line shows the full face of the bat and chips it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full and flighted outside off, Bas de Leede walks forward and across to flick but misses. He is hit on the pads, the ball deflects to covers and they cross for a leg bye.
Michael Bracewell (2-0-16-0) comes back to bowl.
Extra loop on this delivery, landing full on middle, Singh flicks but finds mid-wicket. New Zealand have choked the flow of runs here.
Slow spin back into the batter from outside off, Singh goes back and pushes it to extra cover.
Three wides! That's turned and beaten Latham. Spinning down the leg side, from the leg stump line, Singh gets back to flick but misses. It races behind and they take two.
Floated one, around middle and turning in, Singh defends it back to the bowler.
Too full in length, around leg, Singh goes down low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Up and over the cover region. Loopy and full, around off and turning away, Bas de Leede mistimes his shot off the top edge. It clears the in-ring fielder and they cross.
Googly, around middle and leg, de Leede helps it off his pads to short fine leg.
Back of a length on middle, Vikramjit Singh punches it from the back foot but finds the cover fielder.
Lands it on a length around leg, a cutter, Singh pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, no pace on offer, it's driven to cover-point.
Goes down on one knee to a full ball around off and paddles it towards fine leg for a run.
Slower one, on a length around off, Bas gets down the track to work it around but misses.
FOUR! Blazed away! Full and outside off, Bas de Leede advances down the track and clobbers it over mid off for a boundary.
Loopy and on off, driven down the ground. The mid off fielder ran across to his left and picked up the ball. Could have gone for a single.
Connects with his sweep this time and sends it to deep square leg for a run.
Appeal again for an lbw! Full and around off, turning away, Bas de Leede fails to sweep and is hit on the pads. The impact is outside off.
Tossed up, around leg, swept towards mid-wicket for one.

Shout for an lbw, the finger has stayed down. Ish Sodhi has a close look and then they decide not to review. A googly landing around leg, turning away, Singh tries to defend but misses. He is rapped on the back leg, Sodhi appeals but to no avail. Latham gestures that it has pitched outside leg. The Ball Tracking shows that the ball has pitched marginally outside the leg stump.
Flighted one, drifting in around middle, Singh drives it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, fullish delivery. Vikramjit Singh tucks it towards square leg for a single. Another top over from Colin de Grandhomme!
Pitches it up now, around middle. Bas de Leede strokes it down the ground for a single.
Good-length delivery, around off. Bas de Leede pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower ball, on a length, around middle. Bas de Leede defends it out.

TWO LEG BYES! A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire says no! The impact was probably outside off. A fuller ball, another cutter, around middle. Bas de Leede gets across and looks to sweep this but he misses and gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batters steal a leg bye!
On a length, outside off. Vikramjit Singh steps down the pitch and taps it towards cover for a single.
Tad quicker, a wrong 'un again, around middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
A googly this time, fuller ball, around leg. Bas de Leede gets down and sweeps it towards fine leg for another single.
Tosses it up and serves it full, around leg. Vikramjit Singh gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. Single!
Slower through the air again, around middle, fullish delivery. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out off the back foot.
A low full toss, around off. Bas de Leede sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, fuller ball, around middle, Vikramjit Singh knocks it towards long on for a single. 100 up for the Netherlands!

Drinks break. Things have settled down after the fireworks from the bat of Stephan Myburgh. Runs have dried out and New Zealand are bowling in some tidy overs to regain control of this match. The Netherlands will have to find a way out to keep up with the required rate which has not gone out of their hands yet. They need 235 runs in 192 balls.
Takes the pace off once again, wide of off, fuller ball. Vikramjit Singh pushes it towards point for a single.
Tad fuller now, around middle and leg. Vikramjit Singh advances down the pitch and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Colin de Grandhomme pitches it up again, slower ball, around off. Bas de Leede steps down the pitch and drives it down the ground for a single.
On a length, taking the pace off again, around off. Bas de Leede looks to block this but gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Slower ball, yorker-length delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede digs it out.
Fuller in length, outside off. Vikramjit Singh drives it through cover for a single.
Fuller ball, darting it on the pads. Vikramjit Singh works it away towards square leg for a single.
Tad shorter now, around middle, Vikramjit Singh hangs back and taps it towards mid-wicket.
What a peach of a delivery! Another leg break, around middle, fuller ball. Vikramjit Singh leans to drive this but the ball sneak past his gloves hit the pads and lobs up just over the stumps.
A leg spinner, around middle, a tad shorter now. Vikramjit Singh pushes it to mid-wicket off the back foot!
Tosses it up, outside off, fuller ball. Vikramjit Singh leans and defends it out.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Bas de Leede sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Another slower ball, on the pads, on a length. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out. A maiden over from Colin de Grandhomme!
Well bowled once again! Angling away, slow in pace, on a length, outside off. Vikramjit Singh leans to block this but he misses.
Tad fuller now, outside off. Vikramjit Singh leans and blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Vikramjit Singh opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point.
Another slower ball, on a length, outside off. Vikramjit Singh pushes it towards cover.
Beaten! A slower ball, outside off on a length, angling away. Vikramjit Singh looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floated one, on middle and spinning in. It holds up a bit from the surface as well. Vikramjit Singh goes back and punches it a bit aerially down to long on for a run. 5 singles from the over.
A bit flat and on off, punched towards cover-point for a run.
Spinning down the leg side, tucked to square leg for one.
Uses the spin and eases it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up, on middle and turning down, Singh flicks it past leg slip and picks up a single.
Ish Sodhi comes into the attack now.
Works a length ball off his pads to square leg for a single.
SIX! Put away in style! Short in length, around middle and off, Vikramjit Singh picks this slower one and muscles it over long on for a maximum.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends.
Slower one again, a bit short and on middle, Vikramjit Singh plays late and taps it down to backward point.
Outside off, Singh tries to drive but misses.
Fuller and on middle, at 96.9 kph, Vikramjit Singh drives it down the ground but finds mid off.
Pitches it up and around off, Bas de Leede walks forward and flicks it towards mid on. A wicket maiden for Doug!
Bas de Leede walks out to bat now.

OUT! LBW! An inswinger from Bracewell, landing on a length around off and nipping back in, Max O'Dowd is caught on the back foot, trying to flick but misses. He is pinged on the front foot and they appeal unsuccessfully. Doug Bracewell has a word with Tom Latham and the latter then goes for the DRS. The UltraEdge finds no bat and the Ball Tracking shows that it's hitting the top of the middle stump. The onfield decision is changed and the Black Caps have two in no time.
Full in length, on off and angling in, Max defends it to the off side.
Play and a miss! Back of a length and wide outside off, Max O'Dowd flashes at it and misses.
On a length and outside off, punched through the line but straight to covers.
Pitches it up and outside off, Max drives it off his front foot to mid off.
On a length and outside off, Singh pushes inside the line and misses. Superb over from Colin!
Straighter delivery, worked through square leg for a run.
Vikramjit Singh walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! Stephan Myburgh holes out and we might have seen his last here. Colin de Grandhomme delivers a cutter, a bit short and leaving the left-hander from around off, Stephan Myburgh has to drag it from there and generate all the power by himself but he fails to do that perfectly. Pulls it without much conviction and Doug Bracewell does well to catch it at deep mid-wicket. End of a fantastic knock and Stephan Myburgh has provided the Netherlands with a great platform.
Commentary.Howout: c Doug Bracewell b Colin de Grandhomme

Commentary.Commentary: Takes the pace off this one, delivers it a bit short and on off, at 97 kph, Stephan Myburgh plays a mistimed shot to mid off.
Angling down the leg side, Max clips it to fine leg for a run.
Slower one, short and around leg, Max O'Dowd hangs back to pull but fails to connect with his shot. It goes off his body to the keeper.
Colin de Grandhomme comes into the attack now.
This one shoots up from a length around middle and leg, Stephan Myburgh defends it awkwardly to the off side.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Doug Bracewell tries to repeat the slower one but this time it lands around leg and goes straight on, Stephan Myburgh deflects it off his pads to fine leg for a boundary.
Bouncer around leg, Stephan Myburgh ducks.
Clever deception. Doug bowls it on a length around leg at 109 kph. It lands, grips and spins away from the left-hander, Stephan Myburgh has no answers to it, pushes inside the line and misses.
Forces a length ball in the gap at covers for a single.
Wide called for height! A bumper outside off, it's well over the head of the batter, who leaves it.
Fuller and on middle, defended on the leg side.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Shorter ball, outside off. Stephan Myburgh rocks back and slashes it past point for another boundary. End of a blistering Powerplay 1! Netherlands are 74 for 0 at the end of 10 overs!
Touch shorter, outside off. Stephan Myburgh hangs back and looks to cut this away, but he misses.
Very full this time, around middle. Stephan Myburgh knocks it towards mid on.

FOUR! It's a replica of the previous boundary. All too easy for the southpaw. Michael Bracewell has also repeated the same delivery, again Stephan is down on one knee as he smashes it to the deep mid-wicket fence.

FOUR! Stephan Myburgh brings up his fifty in style! this one comes in with the angle, quicker, around middle. Stephan Myburgh gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards square leg for a boundary. What a knock, what a start from him!
Quicker, around middle, fuller ball. Stephan Myburgh blocks it out.
Another length delivery, outside off, at around 133 clicks. Max O'Dowd opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards point.
Pitches it up again, around off. Stephan Myburgh pushes it uppishly past the bowler for a single.
Much fuller this time, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd clips it toward square leg for a single.
On a length, angling in on the pads. Max O'Dowd looks to flick this but he gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Wide! On a length, down the leg side. Max O'Dowd misses his flick. Wide called!
FOUR! Easy pickings for Max O'Dowd! Touch fuller now, darting it on the pads. Max O'Dowd uses his wrists and flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Tad quicker now, around middle and leg. Stephan Myburgh tucks it towards mid-wicket. Another tidy over.
Fullish ball, outside off. Stephan Myburgh pushes it towards covers.
Huge shout for an LBW, but not given! A fuller ball, around middle and going straight on. Stephan Myburgh looks to tuck this away, but he gets a slight inside edge back onto the pads.
Play and a miss! Shorter ball, outside off. Stephan Myburgh looks to cut this away, but he misses.
FOUR! Stephan Myburgh takes on the spinner! Another loopy, ball, full again, around off. Stephan Myburgh gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Michael Bracewell begins with a loopy ball, fuller delivery, around middle. Stephan Myburgh works it away towards mid-wicket.
Interesting change. Tom Latham has handed the ball to Michael Bracewell.

A muted appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved! A length ball, nipping back in, on the pads. Max O'Dowd misses his flick and gets hit on his front pad. That was sliding down leg. Excellent over from Doug.
Slower ball this time, outside off, a tad fuller. Max O'Dowd guides it towards short third man.
Marginally short, around off. Max O'Dowd defends it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Up and over! Doug Bracewell pitches it up now, shaping away, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives it uppishly over mid off for a boundary. 50 up for the Netherlands!
On a length, tailing back in, around middle. Max O'Dowd blocks it out solidly.
Doug Bracewell begins with a length delivery, angling in on the pads, at 129.1 clicks. Max O'Dowd misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads.
Doug Bracewell comes into the attack.
Change of pace now! A slower one, fuller in length, outside off. Stephan Myburgh looks to heave this over on the leg side, but he misses. 9 from the over.
A length delivery from 'round the wicket now, around off. Stephan Myburgh blocks it out.
SIX! BANG! Stephan Myburgh is on the charge! Kyle Jamieson serves a shorter ball, around middle. Stephan Myburgh picks up the length, and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie!
Well bowled! A dipping low full toss, slower delivery, around middle. Stephan Myburgh does well to keep it out.
Good-length delivery, tailing back in on the pads, at around 134 clicks. Max O'Dowd works it away towards square leg for a single.
Angling in around middle and leg, on a length, at 139.2 clicks. Max O'Dowd flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.

FOUR! Netherlands are racing at the moment! Short in length and around off, Stephan Myburgh turns inside the crease, has his front leg in the air and he pulls it delightfully over square leg for a boundary.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Henry keeps it on a length and in the line of the stumps, Stephan Myburgh covers the line and smacks it through covers for a boundary.
Beautiful delivery. Serves it on a good length around off, at 132. kph. This one lands and moves away late to beat the outside edge of Stephan Myburgh's defensive bat.
Lands it on a length and around off, angling away at 130.3 kph, Stephan Myburgh throws his hands at it and drives it on the up to mid off.
Fuller in length around middle and off, at 135.3 kph, Stephan Myburgh defends it down to mid off.
A touch fuller and on off, angling in at 134.3 kph, Max O'Dowd defends it near his front pad and keeps it out to short mid-wicket.
Extra bounce from a good length around off, Max O'Dowd controls well and defends it from the splice of his bat.
Once again Kyle Jamieson delivers it on a good length around off, at 137 clicks, Max O'Dowd defends it from the crease.
On a length and outside off, Max O'Dowd defends it from the back foot to point.
Back of a length, around middle, it's glanced down to long leg for a run.
FOUR! Whacked! Kyle Jamieson feeds room to the batter, short in length and outside off, Stephan Myburgh slams it over point for a boundary.

Huge shout for an lbw, not given. Matt Henry looks interested in a review but Tom Latham thinks otherwise. It's a length ball around off, nipping back in and striking the batter on the front pad as he fails to work it around. That was not a bad shout. The Ball Tracking though shows that it's going over the leg stump.
Angles it around off, on a length, O'Dowd defends it from the back foot.
In the channel outside off, on a good length at 137.2 kph, Max O'Dowd shoulders arms.
Fuller and on off, Max plays a mistimed off drive to mid off.
Aerial but safe! Short and on middle at 137.4 kph, climbing onto the batter, Stephan Myburgh top-edges his attempted pull shot behind the keeper and it falls safely. They take a run.
On a length and around off, Max taps it down to third man and hands the strike back to his aggressive opening partner.
FOUR! Crunched! This one is on a length and outside off at 134 kph, Stephan Myburgh latches onto it, plants his front foot and fires his drive through covers for a boundary.
On a good length, around middle and skidding off the surface with extra bounce, Stephan Myburgh tries to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge back towards the bowler.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! Short in length, around off, Stephan Myburgh does well to get on top of the bounce and pulls it over square leg for a boundary. He is packing a punch at the moment.
DROPPED! Short and wide outside off, at 131 clicks, Stephan Myburgh cuts it aerially to point where Henry Nicholls jumps but it goes through his hands. They take a couple of runs.
Short and around off, at 130 kph, Stephan Myburgh tries to pull but the bounce gets big on him and he misses.
Who will bowl from the other end? Kyle Jamieson it is!
Fuller and in the line of the stumps, Max O'Dowd defends it back. 13 from the opening over!
Aerial but safe. Width outside off, on a short length, Stephan Myburgh cuts it over point but it doesn't carry to Ish Sodhi in the deep. They cross.
FOUR! Three boundaries in the over and the Netherlands are off to a flying start. Short in length, on off, Stephan Myburgh rocks back and whacks it through covers.

FOUR! Crashed! Fuller in length and around off, Stephan Myburgh gets on the front foot and drills his drive through mid off for a boundary. This could be his last game for the Netherlands and he wants to sign off in style.
Shortish and around leg, Stephan Myburgh stays on the back foot and defends it down on the surface.
FOUR! Up and over! A positive start from the Dutch. Back of a length, around off and angling away, Stephan Myburgh stands back and slaps it over point for a boundary.
